options.systemMessage: You are an accounts payable operations assistant. Write a short plain text daily backlog brief: one opening line with the total number of logged invoices, then one line per route with its count, then one line naming the route that needs attention first. Plain text only, no markdown, no em dash, maximum 80 words.

parameters.content:
## Vendor invoice intake completeness (Ask Questions)
### How it works
The Invoice Intake webhook normalises the payload, then an input guard checks invoice_text is usable. An unusable submission is marked and emailed to the AP desk. One Jev Ask Questions call answers four Noul fields (PO reference, amount, vendor identity, bank details), one Choice (currency) and one Score. Parse Answers derives the missing field list, a blocking reason and requested_details (fields below 0.9 only). A Switch routes three outcomes: three way match, vendor follow up, or human AP review. Each writes its row to the Invoice Intake tab, then notifies by email or Telegram. The ready lane reads the log back first, so a repeated invoice id is flagged, not queued. A 17:00 daily lane counts rows per route and has an AI agent draft the backlog brief.
### Setup
1. POST invoice payloads (invoice_id, vendor_name, invoice_text) to the Invoice Intake webhook path.
2. Credentials: Jev (TypeSafe) API, Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram, OpenAI.
3. Replace the placeholder addresses and point the tab at your sheet.

## Intake guard

Invoice Text Usable? rejects an empty or unreadable invoice_text. The false branch marks the submission and emails the AP intake desk; the true branch runs the Jev Ask Questions call. A rejected payload is never logged.
